items.title: Your Weekly Health Newsletter
items.description: Noticed long-form health articles weren't getting read, so I proposed and launched a visual-storytelling newsletter instead. Led the 4-person editorial team behind it and grew readership significantly.

items.title: Structured LinkedIn Outreach System
items.description: Lead a 4-person outreach team for HR-tech B2B growth, each carrying a 50+ weekly contact target. Personally reached 150+ HR leaders and executives across African companies in under a month.
